rules.title: Security Deposit Amount Limit (Assembly Bill 12)
rules.requirement: Starting July 1, 2024, most landlords can only charge one month's rent as a security deposit for furnished or unfurnished units. Small landlords who own no more than two rental properties totaling four units may charge up to two months' rent if the property is owned by a natural person, family trust, or an LLC whose members are all natural persons.
rules.key_value: 1 month's rent (up to 2 months' rent for qualifying small landlords)
rules.coverage_conditions: Applies to residential tenancies statewide; exemption for small landlords owning no more than two properties with up to four units total.
rules.exemptions: Landlords owning only two rental properties with no more than four residential units total, if owned by a natural person, family trust, or LLC with all-natural-person members, may charge up to two months' rent.
rules.citation: Cal. Civ. Code § 1950.5 (as amended by Assembly Bill 12)
rules.quoted_span: Starting July 1, 2024, many landlords may only charge one month's rent for unfurnished and furnished units

rules.title: Berkeley Security Deposit Interest Requirement
rules.requirement: For tenancies in units fully or partially covered by Berkeley's Rent Ordinance, landlords must pay tenants interest on their security deposit at the end of each year, with a prorated amount if the tenant moves out before year-end.
rules.coverage_conditions: Applies to units fully or partially covered by Berkeley's Rent Ordinance.
rules.citation: Berkeley Mun. Code ch. 13.76 (Berkeley Rent Ordinance)
rules.quoted_span: For tenancies in units fully or partially covered by Berkeley's Rent Ordinance, landlords must pay tenants interest on their security deposit at the end of each year and a prorated amount if the tenant moves out before the end of the year.

coverage.other_unknown_factor: whether the unit is fully or partially covered by Berkeley's Rent Ordinance
